_readme: Edit the text/timings here, then run `npm run build` in pitch/. Footage: ss = start (s) in the recording. Scenes with `voice` last as long as their voice line (+ short pauses); others use `dur` / clip `t`.

scenes.title: Every egg hatches a creature that has never existed before.
NFT pets are 10,000 copies of the same picture.
bullets: Static JPEGs with a few swapped traits — nothing to raise, nothing to bond with
GameFi feels like a job: grind, farm, dump
"Ownership" is a token ID you never look at

scenes.title: A Tamagotchi that lives on Solana — and is truly yours.
bullets: Buy a mystery egg — no picking traits, ever
Hand-drawn parts × palettes × eye colours: 22 trillion looks
Every look is unique — enforced, not just likely
Rarity you can see: Common → Mythic, elemental auras

scenes.title: Your pet plays — and gets stronger.
bullets: Solana Snake: your pet is the snake's head
Every run trains Strength, XP and levels

scenes.title: Strength pays off inside the games.
bullets: Sol Catcher: coins +10, rare SOL +50
Higher Strength = extra lives and shields
Server-checked scores — no fake records

scenes.title: Built mobile-first.
bullets: Block Runner: your pet runs, you dodge
Touch controls, works in any phone browser

scenes.title: Trade pets for real SOL.
bullets: One Phantom transaction: 95% straight to the seller, 5% fee
The backend verifies every payment on-chain before the pet moves

scenes.title: Mystic items change how your pet looks.
bullets: Horn Elixir · Tail Charm · Aura Crystal — SOL only
Training items for PetCoins earned in games and quests

scenes.title: Fast and cheap enough for a pet you check on every day.
bullets: Sign in with Phantom (SIWS) — no passwords, no seed phrases
Sub-second SOL payments, verified on-chain by our backend
Pets mint as Metaplex NFTs; PETCOIN on Token-2022
Anchor & native programs on devnet: player profile PDA, pet passport

scenes.title: Drawn by a real artist — not AI, not empty generation.
bullets: Every horn, ear and eye is hand-drawn in Inkscape by our artist
No AI images, no stock assets — real craft in every pet
Her new parts go live in minutes and multiply the possible pets
